q: How much do polishing and squaring add to a vitrified tile's footprint?
title: Tile polishing line electricity
short: Sub-meter the polishing, squaring and calibration line, multiply its kWh by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh and divide by square metres polished. Add it to the kiln and press figure for polished tiles only, since unpolished tiles skip this stage.

p: Report the polishing energy only on polished SKUs. Averaging it over all tiles understates polished tiles and overstates matt ones.
Polishing removes material as slurry. Its disposal or reuse is waste in Scope 3, or recycled into the body, which you can note.

example.title: Worked example: one month of polishing (illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 298,200 / 300,000 = 0.994 kg CO2 per square metre
example.note: kWh and area are illustrative; use the line sub-meter and production log.
